scraped.scraped_description: Making it easy to write to the politicians who represent you   even if you don t know who they are.

name: WriteToThem
tagline: Email your Councillor, MP, MSP, MS, MLA or London Assembly Member for free
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on mySociety for hosting and maintenance
Dependency on GovEval for data accuracy
Reliance on Mythic Beasts for hosting infrastructure
awards: mySociety recognition for civic engagement innovation
policy_outcomes: Increased constituent contact with elected representatives
outcome_methodology: User engagement metrics and message volume tracking
documented_limitations: Dependent on accurate representative contact data
No guarantee of response from elected officials
jurisdictional_scope: United Kingdom (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, London)
failure_modes: Low response rates from some representatives
curation_criteria: mySociety governance standards for civic technology projects
contributor_governance: Open source contribution model under mySociety oversight
government_partnerships: Partnerships with UK Parliament and local government bodies for data access
political_relevance_summary: WriteToThem addresses democratic participation and citizen engagement. Email your Councillor, MP, MSP, MS, MLA or London Assembly Member for free.

movement_building_utility.notes: Amplifies civic voice or facilitates contact with decision-makers

generalizability_notes: Moderate generalizability — partially open source; core approach could be replicated but may require significant adaptation.
